label: Diagram 2.6
caption: Diagram 2.6 Merging flows at final exit
description: This is a plan drawing, titled in a green banner at the bottom as "Diagram 2.6 Merging flows at final exit", with the note "See para 2.23" at the top left. The central feature is a thick-walled room labelled "Ground floor lobby". At the top edge of the room an "Escape stair" is shown, its opening marked with a horizontal double-arrow dimension labelled "S". On the left wall there is an opening labelled "Storey exit (N)", with a green arrow pointing outwards. At the bottom edge there is an opening labelled "Final exit", with a green arrow pointing downwards and a horizontal double-arrow dimension labelled "W". A diagonal green double-arrow dimension, labelled "D", runs from the Storey exit across the lobby to the Final exit. A vertical green double-arrow dimension, also labelled "D", runs along the right side of the room, between the top-right and bottom-right corners. To the right of the plan a legend defines the letters: "D" as "Minimum 2m, where ‘N’ is greater than 60 people"; "N" as "Number of people served by ground floor storey exit"; "W" as "Width of final exit in metres"; and "S" as "Stair width in metres".
